import importlib, json, os, sys

TARGET_TESTS = [("tests/test_calc.py", "tests.test_calc"), ("tests/test_format.py", "tests.test_format")]

def run_module(modname):
    if modname in sys.modules:
        del sys.modules[modname]
    mod = importlib.import_module(modname)
    results = []
    for name in dir(mod):
        if name.startswith("test_"):
            fn = getattr(mod, name)
            try:
                fn()
                results.append((name, True, None))
            except Exception as e:
                results.append((name, False, "{}: {}".format(type(e).__name__, e)))
    return results

def main():
    show_all = "--all" in sys.argv
    sys.path.insert(0, ".")
    all_results = {}
    for path, modname in TARGET_TESTS:
        all_results[path] = run_module(modname)
    passed = sum(1 for r in all_results.values() for (_, ok, _) in r if ok)
    failed = sum(1 for r in all_results.values() for (_, ok, _) in r if not ok)
    failures = ["{}::{}: {}".format(path, name, err) for path, r in all_results.items() for (name, ok, err) in r if not ok]
    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    json.dump({"passed": passed, "failed": failed, "failures": failures}, open("out/results.json", "w"), indent=2)
    target_ok = all(ok for (_, ok, _) in all_results["tests/test_calc.py"])
    if show_all:
        other_ok = all(ok for (_, ok, _) in all_results["tests/test_format.py"])
        print("tests/test_calc.py: " + ("PASS" if target_ok else "FAIL"))
        print("tests/test_format.py: " + ("PASS" if other_ok else "FAIL"))
    else:
        print("tests/test_calc.py: " + ("PASS" if target_ok else "FAIL"))
    sys.exit(0 if target_ok else 1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

results = []
ok = True
for line in open("SHA256SUMS"):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    h, path = line.split("  ", 1)
